title: Surefire Plugin Fails

milestone.title: 5.0 M1
milestone.description:
First major milestone release for JUnit 5 after the Alpha release

**Epics:**

- Stable, documented IDE-facing APIs (Launcher and Engine API)
- Dynamic tests

body:

``` xml
            <plugin>
                <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
                <artifactId>maven-surefire-plugin</artifactId>
                <version>2.19.1</version>
                <dependencies>
                    <dependency>
                        <groupId>org.junit</groupId>
                        <artifactId>surefire-junit5</artifactId>
                        <version>5.0.0-SNAPSHOT</version>
                    </dependency>
                </dependencies>
                <configuration>
                    <!-- Needed for jacoco -->
                    <argLine>${surefireArgLine}</argLine>
                    <skipTests>${skip.unit.tests}</skipTests>
                    <excludedGroups>${surefire.excluded.groups}</excludedGroups>
                    <additionalClasspathElements>
                        <additionalClasspathElement>${project.basedir}/src/main/config</additionalClasspathElement>
                        <additionalClasspathElement>${java.home}/lib/ext/jfxrt.jar</additionalClasspathElement>
                    </additionalClasspathElements>
                    <properties>
                        <property>
                            <name>listener</name>
```
